answer: To create a fake identity, register a jetty at a specific river mouth, prove control via a real-world garden deed. Burn 50 ETH and wait 3 days per identity. The anchor is the garden deed; duplicates are rejected. Renting the deed costs 200 ETH with 30% risk of exposure. The garden deed must be physically visited and verified by an agent every 90 days for renewal, costing 20 ETH per visit, plus 2 ETH per visit for river transport. 100 identities cost 7000 ETH and 570 days total.
